name: What decisions should I make before electrical trades begin rough-in work?

mainEntity.name: What decisions should I make before electrical trades begin rough-in work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the electrician arrives for rough-in work, you should finalize your layout plans for appliances, task lighting, vanity fixtures, and power outlets. Consider where you need dedicated circuits for kitchen islands, microwaves, or bathroom heaters. As the hands-on project lead, Abraham Becerra reviews these placement details with you during the framing phase so the electrical trade receives precise instructions before drilling studs or pulling wires, preventing costly change orders after walls close.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finalize appliance placements, light fixture locations, switch spots, and outlet heights before framing finishes so rough-ins go smoothly.
